response.overview: The story revolves around two best friends (played by Dipjol and Rubel) whose deep bond turns into intense rivalry due to a severe conflict and misunderstanding, leading them to cut off all communication for years. As time passes, their nephew and niece (played by Riaz and Purnima) grow up and unexpectedly fall in love with each other. The young couple's romantic bond eventually helps bridge the gap, resolve the long-standing feud between the two estranged friends, and bring the families together once again.
response.title: Jomidar জমিদার
